name: statusline
summary: A two-row status line in the band above the prompt, in the terminal and in Claude Desktop: model and effort, worktree, branch and counts, lines changed, kube context, PR and issue counts, session name and output style; then context, 5h and 7d rate-limit bars with pace, cache, cost and time. No statusLine script. In a git repo with a GitHub or GitLab remote it runs gh or glab for the PR and issue counts (forge option, on by default).
